SOLICITOR'S DEPARTMENT (PROFESSIONAL AND TECHNICAL POSTS) SERVICE RULES,
2011
SOLICITOR'S DEPARTMENT (PROFESSIONAL AND TECHNICAL POSTS) SERVICE RULES,
2011
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
2nd November, 2011]
No.SOR-III(S&GAD)1-3/2009,
dated 14-4-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 23 of the
Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of 1974), and in supersession of the
existing rules (only to the extent of the posts reflected in the Schedule
annexed), the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following rules:---
1. short title and
commencement.---(1) These rules
may be called as the solicitor's Department (Professional and Technical Posts)
Service Rules, 2011.
(2) They shall come into
force at once.
2. Method of recruitment
etc.---The method of recruitment,
minimum qualification, and limit and other matters related to the posts shall
be given in the Schedule annexed with these rules.
3. Other terms and
conditions.---The other terms and
conditions of service of the holders of the posts mentioned in the Schedule
shall be regulated in accordance with the terms and conditions laid down in the
offer of appointment issued to such person(s).
